description: The Hair Diagram® specializes in the production and distribution of lace adhesives and other temporary hold products. We are the maunufacturers of the Bold Hold® Product Line and the Ashley Marie Collection®. Bold Hold Active and Bold Hold Extreme Creme are are best selling products to date. We also have a new natural hair cair line, The Ashley Marie Collection®. This collection consists of an assortment of shampoos and conditioners to care for your hair.
